convertibility_reason: Pure tick-scalper with martingale lot multiplication on losses, spread-dependent stop logic, and tick-level execution requirements. Martingale with margin-dependent sizing and tick-scalping dependency makes it mt5_only.

other_exits: Spread-based SL override: if spread > StopLoss in points, SL is set to current Ask - spread*2 (long) or Bid + spread*2 (short) instead of fixed SL, acting as a spread-protection mechanism

position_sizing.conditional_logic: On loss: Lot *= 1.5 (martingale). On win or initial: Lot = Lots (base input). Negative Lots input = fixed lots, positive = fraction of free margin (Lots/100 * AccountFreeMargin / Bid / LotSize)

custom_logic_notes: Martingale lot sizing: each consecutive loss multiplies lot by 1.5x. Winning trade resets to base Lots. Spread-protection logic overrides SL when spread exceeds configured StopLoss in points, using spread*2 as the effective SL distance. The Lots parameter has dual mode: negative value = fixed lot size (abs), positive value = deposit fraction (Lots/100 * FreeMargin / Bid / LotSize). EMA crossover uses previous bar ([1]) vs current bar ([0]) relationship to detect crossover on completed bars but evaluates every tick.
python_conversion_notes: Tick-level scalper - requires tick data for accurate backtest. Martingale lot sizing must be precisely tracked across sequential trades (stateful). Spread-dependent SL override means the actual SL varies per trade based on real-time spread, making fixed-pip SL assumptions inaccurate. The dual-mode Lots parameter (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) needs careful handling. EMA crossover signal can fire on every tick within the crossover bar, so once-per-bar filtering must be added for Python to avoid duplicate entries. Digit adjustment logic (5-digit broker detection) must be replicated for proper pip-to-price conversion.
